timingScope: submitCpuMs is initial main-thread call time. completionMs includes frame/fence waits. activeFrameMs is observed frame delta while the task is pending. gpuWindow is whole-app FrameTimingManager data, including 8 trailing frames; it is not kernel time. Zero GPU timings are unavailable, not zero cost. Graphics memory uses Unity's driver allocation estimate; all-zero values are unavailable. Battery temperature is not GPU temperature. The probe allocates timing records and report arrays outside the initial-call GC counter.
